header.name: Alper Halil
header.summary: Software developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable, maintainable web applications. Skilled in TypeScript, React, and modern UI patterns, with a proven record of elevating code quality, streamlining workflows, and enhancing user experience across diverse frontend stacks.

schraubenhandel.title: IT Department
schraubenhandel.description: Working in the IT department with a primary focus on software development, building and maintaining a wide range of internal tools and infrastructure — from a Next.js employee portal and AI-powered email plugins to search engines, monitoring stacks, and custom agentic AI systems.

1.description: Built a company-wide intranet with Next.js 16 and React 19, serving as an internal employee portal. Integrated LDAP authentication via better-auth so employees can log in directly with their Windows credentials. Locally hosted with a self-signed HTTPS certificate, distributed automatically to all employee machines through a Microsoft Group Policy — which also sets the intranet as the default browser homepage for seamless access without needing to remember internal IP addresses.

2.description: Actively maintaining frontend code and templates for all three company JTL shops, ensuring consistent functionality, branding, and a smooth customer experience across the online stores.

3.description: Built a high-performance search engine over a pool of 100,000+ products across all three shops, delivering sub-10ms search results at scale for thousands of daily visitors. Powered by Typesense, and enhanced with a local LLM aware of the search schema that understands and translates vague user queries into precise, tangible results — helping users find what they need without specific or technical terms.

4.description: Developing a bespoke JTL Shop template from the ground up using Tailwind v4 and Alpine.js, engineered with minimal bloat to deliver the ultimate frontend performance and code quality compared to off-the-shelf alternatives.

5.description: Built a GREYHOUND plugin that supercharges the employee email experience: pre-screens incoming email content and parses it through AI to tag messages with topic badges and urgency categorizations. A sidebar view generates an LLM-based reply to the received email on the fly — before the employee even begins reading the content. Employees can also refine the generated reply through natural language comments or quick actions such as 'reply in English', 'more formal', or 'more friendly'.

6.description: Set up Grafana and Prometheus instances to monitor vLLM server performance and throughput. Deployed a Kener instance to track uptime and availability across nearly all internal services, providing a centralized observability dashboard.

7.description: Built a Model Context Protocol server with 12 layers of safety harness that performs live SELECT-only queries against the production database. Enables non-technical stakeholders to ask business questions in natural language and receive reliable, organized answers via an LLM that dynamically selects the appropriate database tools.

8.description: Built a local agentic interface that exposes OpenAI-compatible endpoints and behaves like a standard LLM, but internally routes queries through multiple layers: pre-processes incoming queries by embedding them and searching a vector database for intent detection. High-confidence intents are answered instantly with prepared responses and tools. Lower-confidence queries are delegated to the LLM, nudged toward fitting sub-agents such as 'order-tracker' or 'shop-assistant', to construct the optimal answer for any kind of user.

ets.title: Software Developer
ets.description: Modernized B2B web applications with React in an Agile, cross-functional environment. Led the Digital Contract project as sole front-end developer, rebuilt legacy B2B apps with a modern React stack, and later led the development of a new B2B UI component library based on UI/UX team standards, enabling consistent UI implementation and significantly reducing the effort transform design into code. In addition, acted as a frontend representative in company's DevOps meetings.

1.description: Transformed Figma designs into a reusable React component library, introducing a CLI tool for easier component integration and organizing documentation with Storybook. Provided reusable React components for Extranet, Intranet, and additional departmental projects, enabling consistent implementation of the new UI Kit across B2B applications and significantly improving design-to-code efficiency. Facilitated cross-team adoption through collaborative workshops and technical guidance.

2.description: Devised and launched a standardized email template system, automating deployments and enhancing consistency. Coordinated with product and design teams to ensure templates met branding and usability standards.

3.description: Improved legacy Extranet and Intranet applications, reducing technical debt as part of ongoing modernization. Fixed bugs on legacy Freemarker code and maintained Java controllers. Built modernized versions by rewriting the frontend in React and integrating with a Java Spring Boot backend through REST APIs, significantly improving reliability and maintainability.

4.description: Started the Digital Contract project as a solo front-end developer, enabling Etstur's contract team to digitalize contract data and track its flow across multiple departments. Collaborated with end-users to deliver solutions, earning company-wide internal recognition for impact.
